bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session" || exit 81
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 82
test -x "$root/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" || exit 83
"$root/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -c 'import telethon; print("TELETHON_AVAILABLE=YES")'
echo SESSION_FILE=EXISTS
echo SESSION_PERMISSION=600
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 echo SYSTEMD_USER_STATE=$(systemctl --user is-system-running 2>/dev/null || :)
 echo SYSTEMD_USER_UNIT=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || :)
 echo USER_LINGER=$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null || :)
fi
echo PRECHECK_COMPLETE
